title: Selling Plans Cancellation Credit Calculation
content:
**Calculation.** On **Selling Plans**, the order worked on is the order of the most recent seller cancellation defect on the seller's Seller Performance Standing record. The cancellation credit is the creditable variable fee credited in full, with no administration fee withheld. The creditable variable fee of a cancellation credit is the variable final value fee billed on the order less every credit already booked on that fee record, administration fees included, and never below zero.

## Inputs and result

| Input | Source |
|---|---|
| Order | The order named by the most recent seller cancellation defect on the standing record |
| Variable fee billed | The amount of that order's variable final value fee record |
| Credits already booked | The credits on that fee record counted before any administration fee was withheld — administration fees included |

| Result | Amount |
|---|---|
| Credit before any fee | The creditable variable fee, in full |
| Administration fee withheld | USD 0.00 |
| Cancellation credit booked | The creditable variable fee, in full, to the cent |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

| | Case A | Case B | Case C |
|---|---|---|---|
| Variable fee billed | USD 26.40 | USD 26.40 | USD 26.40 |
| Credits already booked, administration fees included | USD 0.00 | USD 10.00 | USD 30.00 |
| Creditable variable fee | USD 26.40 | USD 16.40 | USD 0.00 — never below zero |
| Cancellation credit | USD 26.40 | USD 16.40 | USD 0.00 |
